set_openai_key: set the OpenAI API key from an environment variable or provided string
prepare_openai_messages: prepare a list of user role messages from a text content string
prepare_openai_vision_messages: prepare vision messages with base64 encoded images and optional prefix or suffix text
call_openai_api: call the OpenAI chat completions API with retry logic and return the response content
summarize_openai_utils: summarize the OpenAI utility module functions for setting keys, preparing messages, and calling the API
